Golden saffron risotto balls with molten mozzarella centres, crumbed and fried crisp, on a plate scattered with edible rose petals. Cook 300g arborio rice into a risotto with 1 diced onion, a pinch of saffron and 1L stock, stir in 40g parmesan and chill overnight. Shape into 16 balls around cubes of mozzarella from 125g. Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko crumbs. Fry at 180C for 4 minutes until deep golden. Serve with lemon wedges and scatter the plate with edible rose petals.

Sweet chunks of lobster tossed with lemon mayo, celery and chives, piled high into butter-toasted rolls with a pinch of paprika. Chop the meat from 4 cooked lobster tails, about 500g, into chunks. Mix 4 tbsp mayo with the zest and juice of half a lemon, 1 finely diced celery stick, 2 tbsp chopped chives, salt and pepper, and fold through the lobster. Split 4 soft hot dog rolls on top, brush the sides with 40g melted butter and toast in a frying pan until golden. Fill with the lobster and dust with paprika.
W: Sweet pastry shell filled with salted caramel, topped with dark chocolate ganache and sea salt flakes, set overnight.
K: White rum, blue curaçao, pineapple juice and coconut cream shaken frothy and poured over crushed ice, glowing ocean blue. For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 20ml blue curaçao, 90ml pineapple juice and 30ml coconut cream hard with ice until frothy. Strain into a tall glass full of crushed ice. Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. Make four, using 120ml rum and 80ml blue curaçao in total. For a booze-free version, swap the spirits for 15ml blue cordial and a squeeze of lime.

s.how: Cut 500g cod into bite-sized pieces. Whisk flour with ice-cold lager to a thin batter. Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare, like dinner at a lighthouse.

s.note: Arthur drinking with his dad in the biker bar
s.how: Leave 1kg chicken wings uncovered in the fridge overnight, then bake at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and toss through. Mash blue cheese into sour cream for the dip and serve with celery.

m.how: Spread 400g green prawns, 500g mussels, 300g scallops and 400g white fish chunks in a big roasting tray. Dot with garlic butter and roast at 220C for 10 minutes until the mussels open. Squeeze over lemon and serve with crusty bread.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Melt 200g sugar to amber caramel, whisk in 150ml cream and 60g butter, pour into the case and chill. Melt 150g dark chocolate into 150ml hot cream, pour over and set overnight. Finish with sea salt flakes.
